errors.auth.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.auth.emailNotVerified: We couldn't confirm your email. Sign in again with Google or an email code.
errors.auth.forbidden: You don't have access to this. If you think you should, ask your city admin.
errors.auth.suspended: Your account is suspended. Contact {contact} to find out why and what to do next.
errors.auth.mfaRequired: This needs two-step verification. Sign in again to set it up.

errors.common.notFound: We couldn't find that. It may have been removed or moved.

errors.common.conflict: Someone else changed this at the same time. Refresh the list and try again.
errors.common.unknown: Something didn't work. Try again in a moment.
errors.auth.mfaBlocked: We couldn't finish two-step verification. Sign out, then sign in again and follow the steps. If it keeps happening, contact {contact}.
